<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OnlineOrder" name="Online order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderProcess" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FeedbackProcess" name="Customer feedback handling" processRef="Process_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ReturnProcess" name="Return handling" processRef="Process_Return"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Online order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OnlineOrder" name="Online order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Shipment delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Feedback" name="Handle post-delivery customer feedback" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToHandle</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleFeedback" name="Handle customer feedback">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToHandle</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandleFeedbackToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback handled">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandleFeedbackToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToHandle" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_HandleFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandleFeedbackToEnd" sourceRef="Task_HandleFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Return" name="Handle post-delivery return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToHandle</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_HandleReturn" name="Handle return">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToHandle</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandleReturnToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnHandled" name="Return handled">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandleReturnToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToHandle" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_HandleReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandleReturnToEnd" sourceRef="Task_HandleReturn" targetRef="End_ReturnHandled"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Feedback" name="Customer feedback handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FeedbackProcess" name="Post-delivery customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FeedbackProcess" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackProcessToTask</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackProcess" name="Handle customer feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackProcessToTask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackProcessToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackProcess" name="Feedback handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackProcessToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackProcessToTask" sourceRef="Start_FeedbackProcess" targetRef="Task_FeedbackProcess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackProcessToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackProcess" targetRef="End_FeedbackProcess"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Return" name="Return handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReturnProcess" name="Post-delivery return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ReturnProcess" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnProcessToTask</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnProcess" name="Handle return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnProcessToTask</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnProcessToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnProcess" name="Return handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnProcessToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnProcessToTask" sourceRef="Start_ReturnProcess" targetRef="Task_ReturnProcess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnProcessToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReturnProcess" targetRef="End_ReturnProcess"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Online order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order" sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" targetRef="Start_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Participant_Logistics" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer order placement" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerOrder" name="Ready to place an order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStartToChannelChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" name="Choose order channel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustomerStartToChannelChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelChoiceToOnline</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelChoiceToPhone</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" name="Place order through online platform">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelChoiceToOnline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" name="Place order over the phone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelChoiceToPhone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelMergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelMergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToChannelChoice" sourceRef="Start_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelChoiceToOnline" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelChoiceToPhone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelMergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="End_CustomerOrderPlaced"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment and follow-up" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderReceivedToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Automatically generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderReceivedToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Warehouse team picks and packs items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToGenerateLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToGenerateLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateLabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateLabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToSendTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToSendTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendTrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendTrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Shipment successfully delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackAction" name="Take further action on customer feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackAction" name="Feedback action complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return initiated">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnAction" name="Take further action on return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnAction" name="Return action complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReceivedToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Start_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToGenerateLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateLabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToSendTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToAction" sourceRef="Start_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Task_FeedbackAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackAction" targetRef="End_FeedbackAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToAction" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_ReturnAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReturnAction" targetRef="End_ReturnAction"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OnlineOrder" name="Online order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics provider"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder"
                      name="Online order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder"
                      targetRef="Start_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder"
                      name="Phone order"
                      sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder"
                      targetRef="Start_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation"
                      name="Order confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover"
                      name="Shipment handover"
                      sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment"
                      targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation"
                      name="Tracking information"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTracking"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback"
                      name="Customer feedback"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Start_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return"
                      name="Return"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer"
                      targetRef="Start_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Place order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CustomerOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SelectOrderChannel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOnlineOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlacePhoneOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeOrderChannels</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_CustomerOrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerOrder" name="Begin placing an order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStartToChannel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel" name="Choose order channel" default="Flow_PhoneChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" name="Place order through online platform" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineChannel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" name="Place order over the phone" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneChannel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderMergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderMergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToChannel" sourceRef="Start_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineChannel" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderChannel == 'online'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneChannel" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectOrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderMergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeOrderChannels" targetRef="End_CustomerOrderPlaced"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_OrderFulfillment">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PickPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_OnlineOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_PhoneOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderChannelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateShippingLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandoverShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MonitorShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventSubProcess_Return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OnlineOrder" name="Online order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over shipment to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Successful delivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Feedback" name="Further action for customer feedback" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" name="Take further action">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackAction" name="Further action completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToAction" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionFeedback" targetRef="End_FeedbackAction"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_Return" name="Further action for returns" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_FurtherActionReturn" name="Take further action">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnAction" name="Further action completed">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToAction" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FurtherActionReturn" targetRef="End_ReturnAction"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OnlineOrder" name="Online order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Return" name="Return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FeedbackHandling" name="Customer feedback handling" processRef="Process_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ReturnHandling" name="Return handling" processRef="Process_Return"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OnlineOrder" name="Online order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" targetRef="Start_OnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order" sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" targetRef="Start_PhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentHandover" name="Shipment handover" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Return" name="Return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Return"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Place order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerOrder" name="Ready to place an order">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStartToChannel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" name="Choose order channel">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustomerStartToChannel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelToOnline</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelToPhone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" name="Place order through online platform" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelToOnline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineToChannelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" name="Place order over the phone" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelToPhone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneToChannelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineToChannelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneToChannelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelMergeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerOrder" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelMergeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStartToChannel" sourceRef="Start_CustomerOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToOnline" name="Online platform" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelToPhone" name="Phone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelSplit" targetRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineToChannelMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneToChannelMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlacePhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelMergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannelMerge" targetRef="End_CustomerOrder"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_OnlineOrder" name="Online order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OnlineOrder" messageRef="Message_OnlineOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PhoneOrder" name="Phone order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PhoneOrder" messageRef="Message_PhoneOrder"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReceivedOrderMerge" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceivedOrderToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Automatically generate order confirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceivedOrderToGenerateConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickPack" name="Pick and pack items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PickPackToLabel</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandoverShipment" name="Hand over order to logistics provider for delivery" messageRef="Message_ShipmentHandover">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LabelToHandover</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HandoverToTracking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackingToMonitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Delivered" name="Successfully delivered to customer's address">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MonitorToDelivered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_OnlineOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ReceivedOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneOrderToMerge" sourceRef="Start_PhoneOrder" targetRef="Gateway_ReceivedOrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedOrderToGenerateConfirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_ReceivedOrderMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GenerateToSendConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendConfirmationToPickPack" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickPackToLabel" sourceRef="Task_PickPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LabelToHandover" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandoverShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HandoverToTracking" sourceRef="Task_HandoverShipment" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackingToMonitor" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MonitorToDelivered" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="End_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Feedback" name="Customer feedback actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Post-delivery customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FeedbackAction" name="Take further action on customer feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FeedbackAction" name="Feedback action complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToAction" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_FeedbackAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_FeedbackAction" targetRef="End_FeedbackAction"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Return" name="Return actions" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Return" name="Post-delivery return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Return" messageRef="Message_Return"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnAction" name="Take further action on return">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnToAction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnAction" name="Return action complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnActionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToAction" sourceRef="Start_Return" targetRef="Task_ReturnAction"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnActionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReturnAction" targetRef="End_ReturnAction"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
